text: Why you should avoid dating women who never worked in their lives. And to be fair to the ladies, it works the same way towards the guys. Let's keep this simple. This isn't about money. It's about understanding effort. If a person has never worked in their life, they don't really understand what things cost. They don't understand that nothing comes out of thin air, that if you want something, you must put in effort. When you have worked yourself, you start to appreciate the efforts of other people. For example, your parents. You realize what sacrifices they made to provide you with what you have. Why am I talking about this today? Because it often happens that you are a good, decent guy. You meet a girl and you think she's amazing. Good background, educated, high society, all of that. But in reality, this girl has never worked a single day in her life, never tried to earn money herself. You may not realize it at first, but it will almost certainly create problems in the future if you start building a relationship with her. Because if her parents did everything for her, gave her anything she wanted on a silver platter, she usually doesn't understand the value of what is done for her, regardless of her age. She might be 20, 25 or 30. And in a relationship, it will be the same. She will not understand the value of what you do for her. No matter what you do, no matter how much you try to build a comfortable life for her, no matter what gifts you bring her, it will never be enough. There won't be much gratitude from her side either. And at some point, you'll be surprised how you ended up in this situation. She will tell you, you did nothing for me. Why should I owe you anything or be grateful to you? Even if you have been working hard, spending all your time and energy trying to build a great relationship, she may still tell you that she lacks attention, that she needs more romance, that she wants more and more. And then some guys ask, how could I know that she is like that? Well, this is one of your signs. If life brings you together with a girl who has never worked a day in her life, think twice before building a relationship with her.
